bead.title: Add public hot projection query types and capability flags
bead.description:
PROBLEM
The public Rust facade only exposes exact item reads and exact index lookups. The hot projection contract needs typed query request/response shapes before backend work can be implemented consistently.

PROPOSED FIX
Add domain-neutral query model types for filters, typed values, range bounds, sort keys, cursor page requests/responses, aggregate/grouping requests, numeric buckets, bounded mutation requests, and advertised capability flags. Wire the public facade surface as compile-tested stubs that return `EngineError::Unavailable` until backend beads implement support.

IN-SCOPE FILES
- crates/pqueue-core/src/domain.rs or a focused query module for public data types.
- crates/pqueue-engine/src/port.rs for capability/query traits.
- crates/pqueue/src/lib.rs for facade methods that expose the new types.

OUT-OF-SCOPE
- Memory/sqlite query execution.
- Snorri-specific names or policies.
- Aggregation implementation beyond type definitions and unsupported defaults.

CAPABILITY FLAGS
Advertise at minimum: range_scan, grouped_aggregates, numeric_buckets, bounded_mutation, claim_by_query, side_record_query. In this epic `side_record_query` is defined but never implemented — every backend advertises it unavailable (see the epic and contract).
bead.acceptance:
1. `cargo test -p pqueue-core core_domain_tests_hot_projection_query_types -- --nocapture` passes or an equivalent named core-domain test proves serde/validation for query types.
2. `cargo test -p pqueue --test hot_projection_queries capability_defaults_are_explicitly_unavailable -- --nocapture` passes and proves unsupported backends do not silently full-scan.
3. `cargo fmt --check` passes.
